payload.reason: The evidence provides specific methods for dealing with imbalanced datasets, including data expansion and loss control.

claims.text: Data expansion using oversampling is one method to deal with imbalanced datasets, which includes duplicating text with low pattern proportion and modifying text.
Adding loss control in the model helps the model focus on harder cases in different classes, reducing the impact of imbalanced data.
The paper discusses various approaches to handle imbalanced datasets in the context of a neural model for the TN task.
